question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A large number of fish swimming together
solution: The correct answer is: **Shoal** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Shoal **is a noun that means a large number of fish swimming together. (बड़ी संख्या में मछलियाँ एक साथ तैर रही हैं) • It is a one-word substitute for the given group of words. • **For example**: *We saw a shoal of fish in the river.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Stream **refers to a continuous flow of water. (पानी का निरंतर प्रवाह) • **Sheaf **refers to a bundle of grain or stalks of plants. (अनाज का बंडल या पौधों के डंठल) • **String **refers to a thin piece of cord or rope. (डोरी या रस्सी का पतला टुकड़ा) 48:Taf5, The correct answer is: **Impotent**
